title: Native Speech-to-Speech (Moshi / Qwen2.5-Omni / GLM-4-Voice) vs. Cascaded ASR + LLM + TTS Selection Guide

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Non-Streaming Turn-Based Cascade (Batch Whisper-v3 -> 70B LLM -> Sentence TTS)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Legacy offline voice transcription & asynchronous voice notes

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Streaming Clause-Pipelined Cascade (Streaming ASR + vLLM 70B + CosyVoice2 Streaming)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Regulated banking/healthcare IVR requiring strict text audit logs & hotword dicts

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Pure Native Speech-to-Speech (Moshi / GLM-4-Voice with Mimi 12.5Hz RVQ Audio Tokens)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Emotional companionship, roleplay & ultra-low-latency full-duplex chat

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Hybrid Thinker-Talker Omni Architecture (Qwen2.5-Omni + Grounded Tool/RAG Router)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Enterprise real-time multimodal voice assistants needing both <250ms prosody & 96%+ tool accuracy
